purpose: Bind a Vera currentness decision to an explicit proposition/scope-specific requirement profile so individual readbacks cannot self-assert requiredness or silently omit/rename declared surfaces.

requirement_profile.admission_boundary: The evaluator binds the claimed requirements source but does not authenticate or authorize that source. Current VCP/governance admission of the profile is a separate prerequisite.

laundering_resistance: A readback cannot mark itself optional.
Omitting a declared required surface rejects cut construction.
Adding or renaming a surface rejects cut construction unless the requirement profile itself changes.
Moving a surface from required to optional changes the requirement-profile digest.
Changing the declared requirements source changes the requirement-profile digest.
effect_boundary: A CURRENT disposition is eligibility/currentness evidence only. A protected/external effect must separately re-admit authority, exact target/currentness, writer ownership, and effect-specific preconditions.
